$comment: The staff area's alerts (spec 02 §18.2; spec 08 §7.8 group C). access-keys-unavailable is the steward's ruling of 22 Nov: only admin's API half checks the Access token, so only admin writes access.keys_unavailable. L-SAT-09 adds admin-staff-refused, admin-access-mismatch, staff-changed, staff-enrolled and staff-enrolment-refused, each over a line admin writes (identity's staff realm and packages/staff's guard, viewer and member changes, all through admin's telemetry). The staff realm runs only on admin, so admin is each rule's one source and each rule has one series: no field of a line becomes a label. Still owed in catalog/owed.ts, each with why: admin-without-second-factor (admin's request line carries no assurance yet), admin-access-drift and duty-stalled-access-drift (no process runs the Access drift duty yet). Every staging alert routes to staging-quiet, email only.

alerts.name: access-keys-unavailable
alerts.incident_cause: Fin Admin's API half could not read Cloudflare Access's signing keys and refused requests with 503: staff cannot use Fin Admin. Refusals: {{value}}.

metadata.check: Cloudflare's status for Access; the admin service's FIN_ACCESS_TEAM setting against the Zero Trust team name; the release.

alerts.name: admin-staff-refused
alerts.incident_cause: An Access identity that is no active or pending member reached Fin Admin's API, asking for a sign-in code or making a request: Access let in someone the staff table does not list. Lines: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The Access list against the staff table: the line's reason (code_request or request), the request lines with the same requestId, and whether a member was just removed or the Access policy just changed.

alerts.name: admin-access-mismatch
alerts.incident_cause: A Fin Admin session was presented under an Access identity that is not its member's: the session was ended and the request refused (spec 02 §10.5). Lines: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The staff session and Access identity involved: the staffId on the line, that member's sessions and factors, and the request lines with the same requestId.

alerts.name: staff-changed
alerts.incident_cause: A Fin Admin member was added, had their role changed, was removed or had their factors reset: the out-of-band notice of a staff change. Changes: {{value}}.

metadata.check: Whether the change was expected: the line's kind, staffId and actorId, and the staff audit event the change recorded with its step-up intent.

alerts.name: staff-enrolled
alerts.incident_cause: A Fin Admin member enrolled their first factor, and from now on holds their role's permissions. Enrolments: {{value}}.

metadata.check: Whether the enrolment was expected: the line's staffId and method, and who added the member and issued the enrolment code, from the staff audit log.

alerts.name: staff-enrolment-refused
alerts.incident_cause: Staff enrolment was refused more often than its threshold in 15 minutes (a wrong, expired, used or void code, or a factor added outside the enrolment window): someone may be guessing enrolment codes. Refusals: {{value}}.

metadata.check: Someone guessing enrolment codes: the refusals by staffId and reason, and the request lines with the same requestIds and their cfRay.
